prompt_midi: Listen to this audio clip of a single musical note. The recording may have been sped up or slowed down. Identify the PITCH of the note as it sounds in the audio. What is the MIDI note number (an integer from 0 to 127)? Reply with ONLY the integer. Nothing else. Output only the answer.
